name: tailwind-css-expert
description: Use for Tailwind CSS layouts, responsive utilities, component styling, design tokens, states, dark mode, and maintainable utility-first UI.

# Tailwind CSS Expert

- Use consistent spacing, typography, radius, and responsive patterns.
- Extract components when utility sequences represent reusable UI behavior.
- Avoid arbitrary values unless required by the design.
- Implement hover, focus-visible, disabled, dark, and responsive states.
- Preserve semantic HTML and accessibility.
- Keep class composition readable.
